description: Χάρτης πρόβλεψης κινδύνου πυρκαγιάς (Δ/νση Πολιτικής Προστασίας) is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Γενική Γραμματεία Πολιτικής Προστασίας (Κέντρο Επιχειρήσεων Πολιτικής  Προστασίας (ΚΕΠΠ)). Transmiterea hărții de prognoză a riscului de incendiu în timpul sezonul incendiilor din fiecare an, în serviciile implicate și municipalitățile din Tesalia și Grecia Centrală. Coverage: Γενική Γραμματεία Πολιτικής Προστασίας (Κέντρο Επιχειρήσεων Πολιτικής  Προστασίας (ΚΕΠΠ)). The portal shows the English title as "Mappa di previsione del rischio di incendio (Direzione per la protezione civile)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Γενική Γραμματεία Πολιτικής Προστασίας (Κέντρο Επιχειρήσεων Πολιτικής  Προστασίας (ΚΕΠΠ)). Its keywords include Χάρτεσ πρόβλεψησ κινδύνου πυρκαγιάσ, repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 2 download or service links in RAR. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
